authorship: locally maintained native DQL query grammar; no upstream grammar release or archive is claimed

native_contract.interpretation: Native query roots, predicates, functions, parameter/binding/alias ownership, language suffixes and boolean filters retain physical source spelling. This is neither GraphQL nor native predicate schema syntax.
native_contract.decoder_boundary: Dgraph lex.LexQuotedString supplies the escape whitelist; parser.unquoteIfQuoted delegates to Go strconv.Unquote. The stateless scanner validates scalar four-digit Unicode escapes, rejects raw LF, and preserves permitted raw CR/NUL distinctly from EOF. No Go query engine is executed or embedded.

decoder_source_review.scope: Read-only Go standard-library source review supplements the pinned Dgraph call sites; no whole-engine behavioral equivalence is claimed.

binding.leading_utf8_bom: Tree-sitter skips the leading UTF-8 marker before lexing; physical byte spans are not rebased. Whole-source capture remains a separate producer responsibility.

syntax_scope.supported: Named/anonymous queries, parameters, func-generator roots, variable bindings and aliases, selected predicates/count/val, nested functions, language suffixes, pagination arguments, boolean filters, normalize/cascade/ignorereflex flags, and bounded aggregation roots. Argument commas are mandatory with no trailing comma; selection/root commas may be omitted or trailing.
syntax_scope.not_admitted: Mutation/upsert blocks, schema inspection and declarations, fragments, shortest-path roots without a generator, math expressions, groupby/recurse/facets directives, whitespace-separated dashed names, and escaped IRI spellings. These are explicit syntax gaps, not claims of malformed upstream input.
syntax_scope.semantic_boundary: Syntax does not execute or validate query result types, complete function arity/type restrictions, variable definition/use closure, or query meaning.

scope: Standalone native syntax and physical field ownership only; SDK registration, IR production, discovery, service and corpus188 qualification remain separate.

original_fixtures.renaming: Only retained file extensions identify native DQL; every original source byte is unchanged.
